records.description: Splashd suggests The Paddock as a cruising ground. TCV independently verifies an 8-acre nature reserve, public paths and 24/7 public access, but has no evidence of sex/cruising activity; listing-age label is not a witness report.
records.original_source_description: Coming from Tottenham Hale Station on your left hand side you'll find the Paddock Community Park. It's a very small, circular park, with lots of bushes and secret spots. The park has 2 entrances leading onto the same trail.

records.name: Gunnersbury Triangle Nature Reserve
records.location: Gunnersbury Triangle Nature Reserve, Bollo Lane opposite Chiswick Park station, Chiswick W4 5LN.
records.description: Splashd labels this nature reserve a cruising lead. London Wildlife Trust verifies a 3-hectare reserve with ponds, wild woodland paths, visitor use and year-round access, not recent cruising. The precise claimed spot and visitor activity are not independently corroborated.
records.original_source_description: The Reserve is always open and entry is free. Just walk around the triangular paths and choose one of the many benches to wait. Cruisiest spot by the pond and the far end away from the entrance. But anywhere as it's very private.
